data.name: PrunaTextToVideoNode
data.description: Generates a video from a text prompt using Pruna video models, with optional generated sound or an audio track to drive it.

input_details.name: model
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.prompt
input_details.tooltip: Describes the video, its motion and its sound. Up to 5000 characters.

input_details.name: model.aspect_ratio
input_details.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video.

input_details.name: model.duration
input_details.tooltip: Length of the video in seconds. 'auto' lets the model choose the length from the prompt. Ignored when audio is connected: the video then follows the audio length, rounded up to a whole second, up to 20 seconds.

input_details.name: model.resolution
input_details.tooltip: Output resolution. 720p renders about 0.9 megapixels (1280x704 at 16:9), 1080p about 2 megapixels (1920x1088 at 16:9).

input_details.name: model.fps
input_details.tooltip: Frames per second. 48 fps is not available with draft at 1080p.

input_details.name: model.draft
input_details.tooltip: Faster, less detailed render, billed at 60% of the standard rate.

input_details.name: model.generate_audio
input_details.tooltip: Generate a soundtrack for the video. Ignored when audio is connected, which becomes the soundtrack instead.

input_details.name: model.enhance_prompt
input_details.tooltip: Rewrite the prompt with more detail before generation; short prompts need it. Turn it off to reproduce a result exactly with the same seed.

input_details.name: model.seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed for the generation. The same seed reproduces a result exactly only when enhance_prompt is off.

input_details.name: model.audio
input_details.tooltip: Audio that drives the motion and becomes the soundtrack. At least 1 second long; audio longer than 20 seconds is truncated. Sets the video length instead of duration.
